author: Luqman Hakeem
name: Achievements
shortDescription: Define achievements, unlock them or track their progress, save them on the device, and show a toast when one is unlocked.
description:
Add achievements to your game, with no setup.

- Define each achievement once, at the start of the first scene: an identifier, a title, a description and a goal.
- Unlock it in one go, or add progress ("collect 10 coins") and it unlocks when the goal is reached.
- Progress is saved on the player's device automatically.
- Secret achievements hide their title and description until they are unlocked.
- A toast slides in when an achievement is unlocked, with the achievement's own icon (and a sound, with the condition "A toast just appeared"). Change its position, colors, duration and label (to translate it).
- Expressions give the title, description, progress and goal of each achievement, so you can build your own achievements screen.

Achievements are local to the device: they are not linked to Steam, Game Jolt or another platform.

eventsFunctions.name: DefineAchievement
eventsFunctions.description: Define an achievement: its title, description and goal. Do this at the start of the first scene, before unlocking anything. Use a goal of 1 for an achievement that unlocks in one go, or a bigger goal (like 10) for one that unlocks when its progress reaches it. Progress is saved on the player's device.

parameters.description: Goal (1 to unlock in one go)
parameters.name: Goal

eventsFunctions.name: SetSecret
eventsFunctions.description: Make an achievement secret (or not): until it is unlocked, its title and description are hidden. The toast shows the real title when it is unlocked.

eventsFunctions.name: SetIcon
eventsFunctions.sentence: Use image _PARAM2_ as the icon of achievement _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: Use an image as the icon of an achievement. It is shown in the toast instead of the star. A square image works best.

eventsFunctions.name: SetSecretText
eventsFunctions.sentence: Show _PARAM1_ and _PARAM2_ for locked secret achievements
eventsFunctions.description: Change the title and description shown for secret achievements that are still locked ("Secret achievement" and "???" by default).

eventsFunctions.name: ResetAchievement
eventsFunctions.description: Lock an achievement again and set its progress back to 0.

eventsFunctions.name: ResetAll
eventsFunctions.description: Lock every achievement again and erase all saved progress. Useful for a "reset progress" button or while testing.

eventsFunctions.name: Unlock
eventsFunctions.description: Unlock an achievement now. Nothing happens if it is already unlocked.

eventsFunctions.name: AddProgress
eventsFunctions.sentence: Add _PARAM2_ to the progress of achievement _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: Add to an achievement's progress. It unlocks when the progress reaches its goal.

eventsFunctions.fullName: Set the progress of an achievement
eventsFunctions.name: SetProgress
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set the progress of achievement _PARAM1_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Set an achievement's progress to a value (for example the best score or the level reached). It unlocks when the progress reaches its goal. Progress never goes down once the achievement is unlocked.

eventsFunctions.name: IsUnlocked
eventsFunctions.description: Check if an achievement is unlocked.

eventsFunctions.name: JustUnlocked
eventsFunctions.description: Check if an achievement was just unlocked. This is true for one frame only: use it to play a sound or give a reward.

eventsFunctions.name: AnyJustUnlocked
eventsFunctions.description: Check if any achievement was just unlocked. This is true for one frame only. The expression LastUnlocked() tells which one.

eventsFunctions.name: Progress
eventsFunctions.description: The progress of an achievement (0 up to its goal).

eventsFunctions.name: Goal
eventsFunctions.description: The goal of an achievement.

eventsFunctions.name: ProgressPercent
eventsFunctions.description: The progress of an achievement in percent (0 to 100). Handy for progress bars.

eventsFunctions.name: Count
eventsFunctions.description: The number of achievements defined.

eventsFunctions.name: UnlockedCount
eventsFunctions.description: The number of defined achievements that are unlocked.

eventsFunctions.name: IdAt
eventsFunctions.description: The identifier of the achievement at a position (0 is the first one defined). Use it with a Repeat event to build an achievements screen.

eventsFunctions.name: Title
eventsFunctions.description: The title of an achievement. A secret achievement that is still locked gives the secret title instead.

eventsFunctions.name: Description
eventsFunctions.description: The description of an achievement. A secret achievement that is still locked gives the secret description instead.

eventsFunctions.name: Icon
eventsFunctions.description: The name of the image resource used as the icon of an achievement (empty if it has none).

eventsFunctions.name: IsSecret
eventsFunctions.description: Check if an achievement is secret.

eventsFunctions.name: LastUnlocked
eventsFunctions.description: The identifier of the achievement unlocked most recently in this game session.

eventsFunctions.name: EnableToast
eventsFunctions.sentence: Show a toast when an achievement is unlocked: _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: Show (or hide) the pop-up that slides in when an achievement is unlocked. It is shown by default.

eventsFunctions.name: SetToastPosition
eventsFunctions.sentence: Show toasts at the _PARAM1_ of the screen
eventsFunctions.description: Change where the toast appears on the screen.

eventsFunctions.name: SetToastDuration
eventsFunctions.description: Change how long the toast stays on screen.

eventsFunctions.name: SetToastColors
eventsFunctions.description: Change the colors of the toast.

eventsFunctions.name: SetToastLabel
eventsFunctions.description: Change the small label above the title ("Achievement unlocked" by default). Use it to translate the toast, for example "Pencapaian dibuka".

eventsFunctions.name: ToastJustAppeared
eventsFunctions.description: Check if a toast just appeared on screen. This is true for one frame only: use it with the action "Play a sound" to play a sound with every toast.

eventsFunctions.name: ToastAchievement
eventsFunctions.description: The identifier of the achievement shown in the toast (empty when no toast is shown).

eventsFunctions.fullName: Show the toast of an achievement
eventsFunctions.name: ShowToast
eventsFunctions.description: Show the toast of an achievement without unlocking it. Useful to preview the toast's look.
